caption: A sheet of aluminium foil is pressed down over an upturned bowl and lifted off, and the foil keeps the bowl's rounded shape.

sa.check: A sheet of aluminium foil is pressed down over an upturned bowl.
The foil keeps the bowl's rounded shape.
The press comes first, then the lift, then the shape holds.

pc.expect: It wrinkles and moulds to the bowl while pressed and holds that dome after it is lifted away.
pc.fail: It springs back flat; or tears; or does not mould.
It is a different shape; or grows; or shrinks.

pc.expect: It moves only with the hands.
pc.fail: It lifts itself; or slides; or jumps.

pc.expect: The foil lies on the bowl, not through it.
pc.fail: It passes through the bowl; or the bowl passes through the foil; or the hands pass through.

pc.expect: One sheet and one bowl keep their number.
pc.fail: The foil duplicates; or the bowl vanishes; or the foil turns into another object.

pc.expect: The foil's shine and the bowl stay the same.
pc.fail: The foil changes colour; or the bowl changes; or the background rearranges.
